'''Ruka''' and '''Arisa''' are female student NPC who is talking about [[Chisa]]. They can be found on the pathway below in front of [[N.A.N.A.]].

==Location==


==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Ruka:''' Chisa's top of the class again... How impressive...
:'''Ruka:''' She enrolled not long ago but is already caught up. How can I get that good...?
:'''Arisa:''' Why not just ask her for advice?
:'''Ruka:''' Eh?! She feels... I don't know, unapproachable?
:'''Arisa:''' Really? I once had low blood sugar, and she was the first to notice. Took me straight to infirmary and stuffed me with chocolate... Maybe she's nicer than she looks?
:'''Ruka:''' Then what does she like? I should think of some common interests first before I approach her, right?
:'''Arisa:''' I've seen her at the bookstore a few times reading the same novel... something like "And Then There Were No Tacet Discords"?
:'''Ruka:''' "And Then There Were No Tacet Discords"?! I know that one! So she likes classic mystery novels too, hehe...
:'''Arisa:''' More importantly, fix your schedule. You won't bump into her if you're sleeping through most of the day and partying at night.
----
;During {{Quest|Starlights from Yesterdays}} - Search for Runes
:;Chisa is amazing. That giant TD didn't even last a second against her.
:;I figured she was just the brainy type. Didn't expect her to be that good in a fight too...
:;You think this operation might be our chance? To become friends with her?
:;Uh... maybe? Though she kind of never looks us in the eye...
:;Then we go to her first!
----
;After {{Quest|Starlights from Yesterdays}}
:;'''Ruka''' Did you see what happened during that Void Storm?
:;'''Arisa''' You mean that student, Chisa...
:'''Ruka:''' Did you see what happened during that Void Storm?
:'''Arisa:''' You mean that student, Chisa...
:'''Ruka:''' Yup, you saw her too, right? Chisa doesn't follow the crowd. She does her own thing with style.
:'''Arisa:''' Right? I know she excels academically, but standing up to protect everyone? That's next level.
:'''Ruka:''' I almost tripped running for cover, and she caught me. She's actually the sweetest, too.
:'''Arisa:''' Say, aren't you in the Detective Novel Fan Club? What's the membership thing again?
:'''Ruka:''' Read three detective novels, any subgenre... Wait, why the sudden interest?
:'''Arisa:''' Chisa likes detective stories too, right? The fan club could invite her to join.
:'''Ruka:''' Oh, good call! If Chisa wants in, the club leader will definitely approve it. What about you, Arisa?
:'''Arisa:''' Me? If Chisa could be my reading partner... then yeah, I'll join, too!
:'''Ruka:''' Then you've got some homework, girl. You could start with "There Were None," "The Big Quartet, and "Mystery on the Etheric Express."
{{Dialogue End}}

==Note==
* '''And Then There Were No Tacet Discords''' is a reference a real life mystery novel;  '''And Then There Were None by Agatha Christie'''.
